label: Rethink Baxter arm
platforms: any (roslibpy over WebSocket); rosbridge_server runs on the robot network
realtime: none on this host: the robot's controller runs the loop
note: Needs rosbridge_server on the robot's ROS network. Rethink no longer supports these robots. Uses POSITION_MODE, not RAW, so the robot's collision avoidance stays on. No gripper is driven.
